svg.aria-label: Sir Victor. I build the systems behind the money: payments, Salesforce, finance systems, automation and AI.
svg.text: I build the systems behind the money.
Loan books, payment approvals, donor payments, Salesforce automation, and the websites people find you
through. I build software for organisations that need it to be careful with money, keep a record of every
change, and be easy for non-technical staff to use.
